surface.title: Let's get your first useful picture.
surface.body: Start with a rough number, a bank row or the payment pressing first. Nothing is added until you review it.
surface.plainText: Start with a few numbers Money now, next income and what must be paid Add bank activity Paste rows or choose a file Organise debts Minimum payment, due date and pressure Check bills One bill or must-pay item before income Try fake data Open labelled fake data first Start Add what you have Review Check rows Today See your picture
